problem_statement: When an IPv6 interface that disables Multicast Listener Discovery (MLD) goes DOWN and comes back UP, its multicast-group join state is lost. A joined multicast address should remain marked as joined across an interface down/up transition on such an interface (e.g. OpenThread), so that multicast packets continue to be accepted; but currently the join state is cleared on interface down and is not restored on interface up. Conversely, on an interface where MLD is enabled, the join state should be cleared on interface down and then correctly rejoined when the interface comes back up.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/net/ipv6 -s tests/net/ipv6/net.ipv6 -s net.ipv6 -O twister-out --no-clean -W
